conditions_of_stop: ledger transition not attributable to this approved campaign
pytest failure is not one exact assertion failure or its JUnit report is unavailable

criteria.acceptance: Real, imaginary and amplitude checks use rtol=1e-12 and atol=1e-14. Phase uses atol=1e-10 degrees and the NumPy isclose default rtol (1e-5 with NumPy 2.2.6). Maximum residual is <1e-10; frequencies are unchanged.
criteria.oracle: Direct harmonic SDOF at the existing DC and nonzero frequencies; complex response, amplitude, phase and residual.
criteria.oracle_independence: Closed-form scalar SDOF formula compared against assembled-system route; input/assembly not externally validated.

selection.selection_basis: Single TET4 fixture: 12 total translational DDL, one free dynamic coordinate.
